focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 全局总括与新增实验汇总段（Author Rebuttal General Response）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 ICLR / NeurIPS / ICML / CVPR 审稿回复（Rebuttal）最顶部的致全体审稿人总括段（Global Response）：在 150 词内用最提气的语气感谢审稿人肯定，并一眼亮出我们在 Rebuttal 期间赶做出的所有硬核新增实验。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 顶会 Author Rebuttal 置顶总括段（Official Global Response）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [致谢并提炼审稿人共同好评 Gratitude & Shared Praise]：We thank all reviewers for their constructive feedback and for recognizing our work's [Quote Reviewer 1 Praise] (R1), [Quote Reviewer 2 Praise] (R2), and [Quote Reviewer 3 Praise] (R3).

S2 [概览新增实证工作 Overview of New Experiments]：In response to your valuable suggestions, we have conducted [N] sets of new experiments and theoretical analyses, summarized below and highlighted in blue in the revised PDF:

S3 [分条列出硬核新增实验 Bullet Summary of Additions]：(1) Added comparisons against recent baselines [A, B] on [Dataset] (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Evaluated real-world robustness under [Harsh Condition] (Appendix D, R2); (3) Provided wall-clock latency and memory profiling across sequence lengths up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R3).
S4 [诚挚收束 Closing Courtesies]：We address each specific question in the individual responses below and welcome any further discussion.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Synthesize Reviewer Praise -> Announce Concrete Revisions -> Numbered Evidence Bullets mapped to Reviewers -> Courteous Hook. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L010.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: Thank you to all reviewers for your time and comments. We have carefully read your reviews and answered all your questions below. We hope you can raise your scores.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 空洞客套且直接讨要分数（hope you can raise your scores），没有在第一眼展示任何新增实证工作量。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: We thank all reviewers for their constructive feedback and for recognizing our framework's 'principled formulation of the stationarity-amplitude trade-off' (R1, R3), 'strong empirical gains across eight benchmarks' (R2), and 'clear ablation design' (R4). To address your valuable suggestions, we conducted four sets of new experiments during the rebuttal period (incorporated in blue in the revised manuscript): (1) Benchmarked against two latest 2025 foundation models, Chronos and MOIRAI, across all horizons (Table R1, addressing R1, R3); (2) Added real-robot grasping evaluations under dynamic lighting and 25% camera occlusion (Section 4.5, R2); and (3) Included full GPU memory and wall-clock latency scaling curves up to $L=4,096$ (Appendix E, R4). Below we address each reviewer's specific questions in detail.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: AI/CS 小论文：Related Work 批判分类与 Methodology 机制阐述（BP09–BP16）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 相关工作分类综述段（拒绝 A did X, B did Y 流水账）
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想写 Related Work 的一个子方向：把过去三年的 6–8 篇代表性论文按技术路线分成两类进行归纳，并指出它们的共同盲区。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: Related Work 章节各小节首段
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [分类总纲 Taxonomic Thesis]：Existing methods for [Task] can be categorized into two main families: [Family A] and [Family B].
S2 [流派 A 归纳与代表作 Family A Synthesis]：[Family A] approaches (e.g., [Models]) focus on [Mechanism A], effectively addressing [Sub-problem 1].
S3 [流派 B 归纳与对比 Family B Synthesis]：By contrast, [Family B] architectures (e.g., [Models]) reformulate the problem via [Mechanism B] to reduce [Cost/Complexity].
S4 [共同盲区提炼 Shared Blind Spot]：Despite their respective strengths, both families overlook [Critical Factor], which degrades performance under [Target Scenario].
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Two-Branch Taxonomy -> Family A -> Contrastive Family B -> Shared Limitation. 绑定逻辑规则：L009, L008.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: In recent years, many works studied time series foundation models. TimeGPT trained a transformer on large data. Moment used masked pre-training. Chronos quantized time series into tokens. Lag-Llama used lag features. However, our model is different from them.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 典型的“报菜名流水账”（连续四句主语分别是四个模型名），末句 our model is different 毫无营养。
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: Pre-trained time series foundation models generally follow either continuous patch reconstruction or discrete vocabulary tokenization. Continuous reconstruction frameworks (e.g., PatchTST, MOMENT) pre-train encoders via masked patch regression, preserving fine-grained numerical resolution across continuous domains. Conversely, discrete tokenization approaches (e.g., Chronos) quantize scaled observations into fixed bins to leverage cross-entropy language modeling objectives. Despite their zero-shot transferability, both paradigms treat univariate channels independently during pre-training, ignoring physical cross-variable conservation laws that govern multivariate engineering systems.

focal_blueprints.track_name_zh: 学术演讲（Tech Talk）/ 顶会审稿回复（Rebuttal）/ 科研个人陈述（SoP）（BP41–BP48）
focal_blueprints.title_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 针对“创新性存疑（Limited Novelty / Incremental）”的有力澄清段
focal_blueprints.user_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。
focal_blueprints.when_to_use_zh: 顶会 Rebuttal 核心争议攻防段（Novelty Defense）
paragraph_move_structure: S1 [礼貌接招并定位误解核心 Courteous Reframing]：We appreciate Reviewer X's comment on architectural design and would like to clarify the fundamental distinction between our coupled formulation and a naive combination of [A] and [B].
S2 [点破简单拼接为何会失败 Why Naive Combination Fails]：Directly stacking standard [A] and [B] fails on [Problem] because [Theoretical Conflict / Gradient Interference].

S3 [阐明本文核心数学/机制桥梁 Our Core Coupling Innovation]：Our core contribution lies not in using [A] or [B] in isolation, but in deriving the [Specific Coupling Mechanism C], which resolves [Conflict] by [Mathematical Guarantee].

S4 [用直接对比实验一锤定音 Empirical Proof of Non-Triviality]：To verify this empirically, we implemented the exact naive concatenation baseline (`Naive A+B`) in Table R2: our coupled formulation outperforms `Naive A+B` by [14.6%] in MSE, confirming that the performance gain stems from our coupling mechanism rather than mere module stacking.
focal_blueprints.cohesion_and_logic_formula: Clarify Distinction -> Explain Why Naive Stacking Fails -> Highlight Core Coupling Mechanism -> Prove with 'Naive A+B' Ablation Data. 绑定逻辑规则：L019, L016.
focal_blueprints.defective_draft: We disagree that our paper lacks novelty. Although A and B existed before, nobody used them together on time series forecasting. Also our results are very good, so our paper is novel.
focal_blueprints.defect_diagnosis_zh: 承认了“只是把现成的 A 和 B 第一次拿到这个任务上拼起来（nobody used them together）”，等于坐实了審稿人的 A+B 拼凑指控！
focal_blueprints.model_paragraph_en: We appreciate the opportunity to clarify how our architecture differs fundamentally from a naive combination of spectral filtering and neural ODEs. Directly stacking an FFT block with a standard neural ODE fails under abrupt regime shifts because spectral normalization strips the exact boundary values required to initialize the ODE trajectory. Our core technical innovation lies in the bidirectional phase-scale coupling operator (Eq. 7), which uses instantaneous spectral entropy to gate ODE stiffness while feeding predicted scale bounds back to regularize frequency attention. To verify this empirically, we implemented a direct `Naive FFT + ODE` concatenation baseline in Table R2 below: our coupled formulation reduces 720-step MSE by 15.2% over `Naive FFT + ODE`, confirming that the gain stems from our mathematical coupling rather than module stacking.

focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 图表叙事铁律：解读规律而非朗读表格（Interpret Patterns, Never Read Tables Aloud）
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 读者自己会看表格数字。实验段落的任务不是把 Table 1 的每一行数字抄进正文，而是回答三个问题：① 跨数据集的整体胜率与极值在哪？② 哪类基线在什么条件下崩盘了？③ 这种差异验证了我们在引言/方法中提出的什么假设？
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: [Table Reference + Overall Dominance] -> [Contrast between Baseline Families under Hard Regime] -> [Mechanistic Explanation linking back to Method].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 把表格每一行数字机械抄进正文，只报数不提炼规律与原因。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Table 1 shows the results. On dataset A, our model gets 91%. On dataset B, our model gets 88%. Our model is the best on all datasets.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Table 1 shows that our model achieves the lowest forecasting error on 26 out of 30 benchmark settings. While point-wise Transformers degrade rapidly on volatile electricity load datasets (e.g., ECL), our multi-scale spectral mixer reduces MSE by an average of 16.4%, confirming that frequency-domain denoising stabilizes long-horizon representations.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 既有全局概览（26/30 最优），又有困难场景（波动剧烈的电力负载 ECL）下的流派对比，最后回扣方法论核心假设。

focal_logic_rules.category: Logical Fallacy Prevention (逻辑谬误防范)
focal_logic_rules.name_zh: 破除二元对立谬误：展现多维权衡（Transcending False Dichotomies）
focal_logic_rules.name_en: Moving Beyond False Dichotomies to Pareto Trade-offs
focal_logic_rules.core_principle_zh: 无论是讨论模型设计（精度 vs. 速度、生成多样性 vs. 保真度）还是社会议题（发展 AI vs. 保护就业、基础理论 vs. 工程应用），避免非黑即白的极端断言；用兼容性或帕累托改进框架（reconcile / bridge / balance X and Y by...）构建高阶论点。
focal_logic_rules.structural_formula: Rather than treating [Goal A] and [Goal B] as mutually exclusive, [Approach/Policy] reconciles both by [Mechanism C].
focal_logic_rules.common_pitfall_zh: 非此即彼，为了夸大一端而把另一端贬得一无是处。
focal_logic_rules.bad_example_en: Universities should stop teaching theoretical courses and only teach practical coding skills.
focal_logic_rules.good_example_en: Rather than treating mathematical foundations and engineering practice as mutually exclusive, computer science curricula can integrate both by embedding convex optimization and probability theory directly into hands-on machine learning studio projects.
focal_logic_rules.analysis_zh: 用 Rather than treating A and B as mutually exclusive, ... reconciles/integrates both by... 展现成熟严密的学术思辨。

focal_revision_cases.domain_zh: 雅思小作文动态/静态图表与实证数据综述
focal_revision_cases.primary_defect_category: 机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）
focal_revision_cases.communicative_goal_zh: 我这一段想写 ICLR / NeurIPS / ICML / CVPR 审稿回复（Rebuttal）最顶部的致全体审稿人总括段（Global Response）：在 150 词内用最提气的语气感谢审稿人肯定，并一眼亮出我们在 Rebuttal 期间赶做出的所有硬核新增实验。
focal_revision_cases.original_defective_paragraph: Thank you to all reviewers for your time and comments. We have carefully read your reviews and answered all your questions below. We hope you can raise your scores.

seven_point_diagnosis_zh.1_controlling_idea: 原段中心论点被套话或碎片句淹没，首句未能直接立论。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.2_subject_length_and_balance: 存在【机械连接词膏药 + 旧新信息流断裂与逻辑跳跃（Mechanical Connectors & Logical Leap）】：主语冗长或句子结构松散，违反尾重原则（L011）。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.3_given_to_new_flow: 句间缺乏旧信息向新信息的平滑过渡（违反 L015 图表叙事铁律：解读规律而非朗读表格（Interpret Patterns, Never Read Tables Aloud））。
seven_point_diagnosis_zh.4_anaphora_and_connectors: 存在裸露的 This/It 指代或机械使用 First/Second/Moreover。

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Instantiating closed-loop visuomotor diffusion on physical robots entails two technical challenges. First, because raw depth camera streams contain occlusion artifacts around reflective object edges, we introduce a tactile-guided cross-attention gate that reweights visual tokens upon contact onset. Second, to eliminate the 200 ms sampling bottleneck of iterative denoising, we formulate a trajectory consistency distillation objective that maps Gaussian noise directly to collision-free action chunks in two forward steps. Together, these designs sustain 50 Hz reactive control under partial visual occlusion.

focal_revision_cases.revised_idiomatic_paragraph_en: Despite its strong empirical performance, our framework exhibits two theoretical boundaries worth noting. First, while our spectral branch scales quasi-linearly with sequence length, computing pairwise Hilbert phase differences scales quadratically with channel count ($O(C^2)$), which increases memory footprint when $C > 2,000$; incorporating anchor-based low-rank graph sparsification provides a direct remedy. Second, our continuous neural-ODE scale tracker assumes piece-wise smooth drift and may smooth over instantaneous step discontinuities caused by sensor recalibration. Extending the continuous drift prior to jump-diffusion stochastic differential equations offers a principled direction for future investigation.
